patterns: No PYQs filed here; APPSC Group 2 keys cited in notes show the style: direct 'who/where' items (Brown library = Kadapa, Asamardhuni Jeevayatra = Gopichand, first Bellary magazine).
Expect book-author matches (Gabbilam, Veyi Padagalu, Kanyasulkam, Rajasekhara Charitram) and 'father of' titles.
Traps: Satyaduta vs Tatvabodhini for Bellary; Schultze vs Campbell for first grammar; Rajasekhara Charitram vs Mahasweta for first novel.
App MCQs cite exam keys in stems and drift into unrelated AP history (Ikshvakus, Vasavi) - better phrased as plain facts.
